config_yaml:
schema_version: 1
repository: owner/consumer
repository_id: R_fixture
project_id: P_fixture
owner_id: U_fixture
ready_status: Ready
allowed_paths:
  - fixture/greeting.go
profile:
  agent: copilot
  secret_env: SOFA_MODEL_TOKEN
limits:
  attempt_seconds: 600
  repair_attempts: 2
  infra_retries: 1
  max_agent_turns: 5
  max_files: 5
  max_file_bytes: 131072
  max_total_bytes: 524288
checks:
  - id: go-test
    argv: [go, test, ./...]
    timeout_seconds: 120
lifecycle:
  statuses:
    inbox: Inbox
    discovery: Discovery
    spec_review: Spec Review
    backlog: Backlog
    ready: Ready
    building: Building
    verification: Verification
    review: Review
    release: Release
    done: Done
